classification.difficultyReason: Construct three different rectangles for each fixed perimeter, choosing different pairs of side lengths.

content.prompt: For each part below, draw three different rectangles with the given perimeter.

answer.short: Sample answers: rectangles measuring $1\text{ cm}\times8\text{ cm}$, $2\text{ cm}\times7\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Choose three different pairs of side lengths whose sum is $9\text{ cm}$. Draw a rectangle for each pair.
$$\begin{align*}P_1&=1+8+1+8=18\text{ cm}\\P_2&=2+7+2+7=18\text{ cm}\\P_3&=3+6+3+6=18\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three authored sample rectangles, drawn to a common scale and labelled with their dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Side pairs 1 and 8, 2 and 7, 3 and 6 centimetres each give perimeter 18 centimetres.
